# The Extended Essay Academy
> A self-study course for IB students writing their Extended Essay. 14 structured modules covering research, structure, academic writing, and IB assessment criteria. Built by a student who scored 32/34.

This is an educational platform — not an essay writing service. Students learn to write their own essays.
